scope_argument: The reviewed proof treats every complex terminal Calabi–Yau fibre space in the original Li–Zhao model with normal projective Q-factorial total space, relative numerical triviality and relative dimension zero, one or two. It includes every admitted real boundary, every permitted base, arbitrary total dimension and all lineality of the closed movable cone. The marked generic descent and operator-domain construction give the chamber for the actual quotient group on the actual effective generic image. The finite vertical-kernel and lifting theorem give a rational polyhedral cone Π in C=closure(Mov(X/S))∩Eff(X/S) for the full original faithful support-preserving numerical group Γ. Its translates cover C, and every nonidentity whole closed translate avoids Int(Π), with trivial setwise stabilizer. The explicit zero-dimensional, low-absolute-dimensional and U=0 branches complete all quantifiers.
